note: Official program and records-request directory (spec 09, Phase 1 help directory). Every rule is quoted from the captured official page named by its claim id in research/claims/claims.json; the quote must be found there by scripts/verify_claims.py before it can appear on a public surface. This file describes programs and issuers. It stores nothing about any person and calculates no deadline.
disclaimer: This directory quotes official rules with their sources. It does not decide eligibility, calculate a deadline or file anything. Rules change; read the linked official page before acting. Not legal advice.
